reports.name: Modelo 130
reports.description: IRPF quarterly payment on account for self-employed professionals under direct estimation.

workflows.name: Prepare quarterly IRPF inputs
workflows.description: Collect quarterly revenue, deductible expenses, withholdings, and prior-period payment data before opening Modelo 130.

workflows.name: Submit Modelo 130
workflows.description: Submit the quarterly payment-on-account return during the applicable submission window.

workflows.name: Settle the quarterly IRPF payment
workflows.description: Pay the resulting installment by the same quarterly deadline or confirm that no payment is due.

events.title: Q1 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Submission window runs from 1 to 20 April for the first quarter.

events.title: Q1 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Payment on account is due with the first-quarter filing.

events.title: Q2 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Submission window runs from 1 to 20 July for the second quarter.

events.title: Q2 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Payment on account is due with the second-quarter filing.

events.title: Q3 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Submission window runs from 1 to 20 October for the third quarter.

events.title: Q3 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Payment on account is due with the third-quarter filing.

events.title: Q4 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Submission window runs from 1 to 30 January of the following year for the fourth quarter.

events.title: Q4 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Payment on account is due with the fourth-quarter filing.

reports.name: Modelo 303
reports.description: Quarterly IVA self-assessment return for ordinary VAT filers.

workflows.name: Reconcile quarterly IVA
workflows.description: Reconcile output IVA, deductible input IVA, corrections, and prior-period balances before filing.

workflows.name: Submit Modelo 303
workflows.description: Submit the quarterly IVA self-assessment during the applicable submission window.

workflows.name: Settle payable IVA
workflows.description: Pay the resulting IVA balance by the quarterly deadline or preserve the refund/offset position.

events.title: Q1 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly IVA return for Q1 is due by 20 April.

events.title: Q1 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Any payable IVA for Q1 is due with the return.

events.title: Q2 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly IVA return for Q2 is due by 20 July.

events.title: Q2 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Any payable IVA for Q2 is due with the return.

events.title: Q3 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly IVA return for Q3 is due by 20 October.

events.title: Q3 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Any payable IVA for Q3 is due with the return.

events.title: Q4 2026 submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly IVA return for Q4 is due by 30 January of the following year.

events.title: Q4 2026 payment deadline
events.description: Any payable IVA for Q4 is due with the return.

reports.name: Modelo 390
reports.description: Annual IVA summary return, where required, submitted with the final VAT return window.

workflows.name: Confirm Modelo 390 requirement
workflows.description: Determine whether the taxpayer must file the annual IVA summary or is covered by an exemption.

workflows.name: Reconcile annual IVA totals
workflows.description: Compare annual totals against quarterly Modelo 303 filings and accounting records.

workflows.name: Submit Modelo 390
workflows.description: Submit the annual IVA summary during the January annual-summary window when required.

events.title: 2026 annual summary submission deadline
events.description: Annual IVA summary is submitted during the 1 to 30 January final VAT window where required.

workflows.name: Review intra-Community activity
workflows.description: Review ROI status, customer and supplier VAT numbers, and intra-Community transaction records.

workflows.name: Determine Modelo 349 frequency
workflows.description: Confirm whether the taxpayer files monthly, quarterly, or under another applicable frequency.

workflows.name: Submit Modelo 349
workflows.description: Submit the recapitulative statement for the applicable period by the submission deadline.

events.title: Q1 2026 quarterly submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly Modelo 349 is due during the first 20 calendar days after the quarter.

events.title: Q2 2026 quarterly submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly Modelo 349 is due during the first 20 calendar days after the quarter.

events.title: Q3 2026 quarterly submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly Modelo 349 is due during the first 20 calendar days after the quarter.

events.title: Q4 2026 quarterly submission deadline
events.description: Fourth-quarter Modelo 349 is due during the first 30 calendar days of January.

reports.name: Modelo 100
reports.description: Annual IRPF Renta return for the 2025 income year, filed during the 2026 Renta campaign.

workflows.name: Review Renta taxpayer data
workflows.description: Review draft taxpayer data, employment/self-employment income, deductions, family circumstances, and regional items.

workflows.name: Submit Modelo 100
workflows.description: Submit the annual Renta return during the campaign window after confirming the final calculation.

workflows.name: Choose Renta payment method
workflows.description: If the return is payable, choose single payment or the special 60/40 split payment option and track both payment dates.

events.title: 2025 Renta submission deadline
events.description: Modelo 100 for the 2025 IRPF campaign may be filed from 8 April to 30 June 2026.

events.title: Single payment or first split payment deadline
events.description: If the Renta result is payable, the single payment is due by the filing deadline. When using the special split option, 60% is paid when the declaration is submitted.

events.title: Second split payment deadline
events.description: When the special split payment option is selected, the remaining 40% is due by 5 November 2026.
